neighbours.label: A lone letter token c / d / p / D that starts a word after '(', '-' or a space, in a few continuations: (c[aramel], -d[renched], -d[ried], -p[ump], D[ill]; whole-word tokens and other splits (-c[arts], d[arts], Dijon) are quiet. The + pole is the same single letters where 'art' follows
fire: The waiter brought a slice of flan (caramel pudding) and two small spoons.
Breakfast was a plate of syrup-drenched pancakes and a pot of black tea.
Toss the pasta with sun-dried tomatoes, garlic and a little olive oil.

Poached Trout with Dill Sauce
2 trout fillets, skin on
The cardiac team chose an off-pump technique for the elderly patient.
We came home rain-drenched and hung our coats by the stove.
For the topping, melt the dulce de leche (caramel spread) over low heat.
The plumber replaced the heat-pump in the cellar before winter.
quiet: The waiter brought a slice of flan with vanilla pudding and two small spoons.
Breakfast was a plate of butter-soaked pancakes and a pot of black tea.
Toss the pasta with oven-roasted tomatoes, garlic and a little olive oil.

Poached Trout with Lemon Sauce
2 trout fillets, skin on
The cardiac team chose a keyhole technique for the elderly patient.
The peasants arrived with ox-carts and mule-carts piled high with hay.
A swallow darts over the pond and the children go caving in the hills.
The plumber replaced the boiler in the cellar before winter.

notes: Card: '-p' x3, '-c' x3, '-d' x2, ' D' x2: '(c[aramel]', 'syrup[-d]renched', 'Off[-p]ump', ' D[ill] Sauce', 'D[utch]'. Probes: (caramel 1.00, Dill Butter 0.66, -pump 0.62, -drenched 0.56, Dill Sauce 0.51, sun-dried 0.49; Dijon 0.13, Dutch oven 0.05, -carts 0.06, caving 0.07, darts 0.00, -soaked/-whipped 0.02, -pressed/-smoked 0.03, -driven/-pass 0.00. What decides which splits fire is not established; the label lists the cases seen.
